verdict.rationale: Docs show strong API/Terraform parity for core resources (clusters, node pools, inference, storage, billing export via FOCUS API), but some UI-only tools like 'Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console' and quota viewing/increase requests are described only as console actions with no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit API/CLI equivalents for Capacity Finder and quota management, and independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-reachable.
